subject: Making payment webhooks safe to retry

concepts.name: Retries with backoff
concepts.why_it_matters: Networks fail briefly all the time; retrying turns a temporary failure into a delay instead of a lost message

in_your_work.summary: The payment provider re-sent a payment notice because the app answered too slowly

concepts.name: Idempotency
concepts.why_it_matters: Retries are only safe if doing the same thing twice has the same effect as doing it once

in_your_work.summary: The payment handler now remembers each notice and ignores repeats

concepts.name: Transactions
concepts.why_it_matters: A duplicate check done separately from the work still lets two simultaneous repeats both pass

in_your_work.summary: Saving the notice ID and updating the order now happen together in the database

discarded.detail: Timestamps are formatted with a date library
discarded.reason: Does not change the mental model

evidence.supports: User saw the same webhook arrive twice after a slow response
